modalities.evidence: EEG: Probabilistic Learning with Affective Feedback
RL task in N=25 college age participants

output.population: Human; N=25 college age participants, healthy/control, ages 18–27
output.summary: EEG recorded during a probabilistic selection reinforcement learning task with affective feedback in college-age participants, collected circa 2019, accompanying a study of the reward positivity. This is the second experiment.
